known_limits: Cumulative citations are as of the snapshot, not all citations received during the filtered period.
Works are mapped to a journal through their primary source in OpenAlex; a work is counted once.
SDGs and topics are automatic classifications; multiple categories can overlap.
Networks show the largest subset, at most 40 nodes and 150 links.
PDFs and XML are not harvested; links and availability follow the source metadata.
